basis: Observed acceptance gates: the maintainer requested a 2-second goal and 3-second maximum. The existing development comparison exposed action misclassification; 95% whole-request correctness and 80% per-family correctness prevent speed alone selecting a candidate. Saved-locator mutation robustness stays a separate regression track. Gates must be frozen with baseline evidence before held-out requests.
uncertainty: Minimum coverage is a practical experiment floor, not statistical certification. Report the two-sided 95% Wilson interval over held-out families whose every planned request is correct and complete within the deadline; related requests and repetitions do not count as independent families. Authored families are not a random sample of production traffic.
